workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 斜坡設計練習：SPS 周長 6911.5 m、ρ = 741.3 m，從 26 GeV/c 加速到 450 GeV/c，Bρ 由 86.7 增到 1501 T·m，B 由 0.117 增到 2.02 T。假設平均斜率 Ḃ = 0.2 T/s：斜坡時間 = (2.025 − 0.117)/0.2 ≈ 9.5 s；每圈能量增益 ΔE = e·ρ·Ḃ·C = 741.3×0.2×6911.5 ≈ 1.02 MeV；f_rev = 43.38 kHz，斜坡約 9.5×43 380 ≈ 4.1×10⁵ 圈，4.1×10⁵×1.02 MeV ≈ 424 GeV，與 450 − 26 = 424 GeV/c 的動量增量一致。若可用射頻電壓為 7 MV（假設），同步相位 sin φs = 1.02/7 ≈ 0.146，φs ≈ 8.4°，仍保留足夠的桶面積；把 Ḃ 提高到 0.4 T/s 則 ΔE ≈ 2.05 MeV、sin φs ≈ 0.29，桶面積明顯縮小，大強度束流更易失捕。數值為教學假設，不代表實際運轉設定。
workedExample.textEn: Ramp-design exercise: with C = 6911.5 m and ρ = 741.3 m, accelerating from 26 GeV/c to 450 GeV/c raises Bρ from 86.7 to 1501 T·m and B from 0.117 to 2.02 T. Assuming an average Ḃ = 0.2 T/s, the ramp lasts (2.025 − 0.117)/0.2 ≈ 9.5 s; the energy gain per turn is ΔE = e·ρ·Ḃ·C = 741.3×0.2×6911.5 ≈ 1.02 MeV; at f_rev = 43.38 kHz the ramp spans about 9.5×43 380 ≈ 4.1×10⁵ turns, and 4.1×10⁵×1.02 MeV ≈ 424 GeV matches the 450 − 26 = 424 GeV/c momentum gain. With 7 MV of RF voltage (assumed) the synchronous phase is sin φs = 1.02/7 ≈ 0.146, φs ≈ 8.4°, leaving ample bucket area; raising Ḃ to 0.4 T/s gives ΔE ≈ 2.05 MeV and sin φs ≈ 0.29, visibly shrinking the bucket so high-intensity beam is more easily lost. Values are teaching assumptions, not operational settings.

workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。

steps.title: 磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「744 台主偶極磁鐵」如何決定CERN 超級質子同步加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “744 main dipole magnets” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPS 是周長約 6.9 km（6911 m）的常溫磁鐵同步加速器，質子的軌道由 744 台偶極磁鐵決定。粒子動量 p、磁場 B 與彎轉半徑 ρ 滿足 Bρ = p/e，工程上寫成 Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c]。因為 ρ 被隧道幾何固定，同步加速器必須讓磁場隨動量同步上升，並以射頻頻率鎖住軌道長度；注入端的低場與頂端的高場相差十幾倍，兩端的場品質都要顧到。總彎轉角 2π 由所有偶極的磁長分攤，其餘周長留給四極、直線段、射頻腔與注入引出設備。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「744 台主偶極磁鐵」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The SPS is a warm-magnet synchrotron about 6.9 km (6911 m) in circumference whose proton orbit is set by 744 dipole magnets. Momentum p, field B and bending radius ρ obey Bρ = p/e, written in engineering units as Bρ[T·m] = 3.3356·p[GeV/c]. Because ρ is fixed by the tunnel geometry, a synchrotron must raise the field in step with momentum while the RF frequency locks the orbit length; injection and top fields differ by more than a factor of ten, and field quality matters at both ends. The total 2π bend is shared among the dipoles' magnetic lengths, and the rest of the circumference holds quadrupoles, straight sections, RF cavities and injection and extraction equipment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “744 main dipole magnets”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：744 台偶極各磁長 6.26 m，總磁長 4657 m = 2πρ，得 ρ ≈ 741.3 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With 744 dipoles of 6.26 m magnetic length, the total 4657 m equals 2πρ, so ρ ≈ 741.3 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「744 台主偶極磁鐵」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “744 main dipole magnets”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「744 台主偶極磁鐵」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “744 main dipole magnets” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：744 台偶極各磁長 6.26 m，總磁長 4657 m = 2πρ，得 ρ ≈ 741.3 m。450 GeV/c：Bρ = 3.3356×450 = 1501 T·m，B = 1501/741.3 ≈ 2.02 T；26 GeV/c 注入：Bρ = 86.7 T·m，B ≈ 0.117 T；400 GeV/c 慢引出：Bρ = 1334 T·m，B ≈ 1.80 T。注入到頂端的場強比約 17.3，電源與磁場量測須在此動態範圍內維持 10⁻⁴ 級再現性。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With 744 dipoles of 6.26 m magnetic length, the total 4657 m equals 2πρ, so ρ ≈ 741.3 m. At 450 GeV/c, Bρ = 3.3356×450 = 1501 T·m and B = 1501/741.3 ≈ 2.02 T; at 26 GeV/c injection Bρ = 86.7 T·m and B ≈ 0.117 T; at 400 GeV/c slow extraction Bρ = 1334 T·m and B ≈ 1.80 T. The injection-to-top field ratio is about 17.3, and power converters and field measurement must stay reproducible to 10⁻⁴ across that dynamic range. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以串接在主偶極迴路中的參考磁鐵感應線圈產生即時 B 訊號（B-train），與電源電流讀值並列記錄；在固定 RF 頻率下小幅改變偶極電流，以 BPM 量平均徑向位移 Δx = D·δ 反推動量偏差，確認 B 與 p 的對應；各能量平台都重做一次，建立整個斜坡的 B–I–p 對照表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Generate a real-time field signal (B-train) from pick-up coils in a reference magnet powered in series with the main dipoles and log it beside the converter current; at fixed RF frequency step the dipole current slightly and read the mean radial shift Δx = D·δ on the BPMs to infer the momentum offset, confirming the B–p correspondence; repeat on every energy plateau to build a B–I–p table across the ramp.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 磁剛度、彎轉半徑與 450 GeV 的場強：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「744 台主偶極磁鐵」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “744 main dipole magnets” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以串接在主偶極迴路中的參考磁鐵感應線圈產生即時 B 訊號（B-train），與電源電流讀值並列記錄；在固定 RF 頻率下小幅改變偶極電流，以 BPM 量平均徑向位移 Δx = D·δ 反推動量偏差，確認 B 與 p 的對應；各能量平台都重做一次，建立整個斜坡的 B–I–p 對照表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Generate a real-time field signal (B-train) from pick-up coils in a reference magnet powered in series with the main dipoles and log it beside the converter current; at fixed RF frequency step the dipole current slightly and read the mean radial shift Δx = D·δ on the BPMs to infer the momentum offset, confirming the B–p correspondence; repeat on every energy plateau to build a B–I–p table across the ramp. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若注入平台的磁場因前一循環的磁滯歷史偏離 0.1%，在固定 RF 頻率下束流動量與磁場不匹配，色散 D = 3 m 處閉合軌道徑向偏移約 3 mm，注入效率下降，束流在色散大的位置刮到孔徑並造成活化。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the injection-plateau field departs by 0.1% because of the previous cycle's hysteresis history, beam momentum and field no longer match at fixed RF frequency, the closed orbit moves about 3 mm radially where D = 3 m, injection efficiency drops and the beam scrapes the aperture in high-dispersion regions, activating them.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity, bending radius and the field at 450 GeV: failure diagnosis

steps.title: 射頻諧波數、轉變能與 Q20 光學：原理與系統邊界

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “200 MHz travelling-wave cavities” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPS 以 200 MHz 行波腔加速，諧波數 h = f_RF/f_rev 決定環上射頻「桶」的數目；LHC 型束流以 25 ns 間隔佔據每 5 個 5 ns 桶中的 1 個。縱向穩定取決於滑相因子 η = 1/γt² − 1/γ²：高於轉變能時，動量較高的粒子繞一圈反而較慢。SPS 從 Q26 改用 Q20 光學，把轉變能 γt 由約 22.8 降到約 18，使 26 GeV/c 注入時 |η| 變大，同步頻率與不穩定性門檻跟著提高；固定靶束流若以 14 GeV/c（γ ≈ 15）注入，仍須在斜坡中穿越轉變能。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「200 MHz 行波加速腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The SPS accelerates with 200 MHz travelling-wave cavities, and the harmonic number h = f_RF/f_rev sets how many RF buckets fit around the ring; LHC-type beams at 25 ns spacing fill one in every five 5 ns buckets. Moving from Q26 to Q20 optics lowered the transition gamma from about 22.8 to about 18, enlarging |η| at 26 GeV/c injection and raising both the synchrotron frequency and instability thresholds; fixed-target beams injected at 14 GeV/c (γ ≈ 15) still cross transition during the ramp. steps.failure: 常見誤解：「轉變能只是低能機器的問題，SPS 這種高能機器不必考慮。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f_rev = c/C = 2.998×10⁸/6911.5 ≈ 43.38 kHz；h = 4620 時 f_RF ≈ 200.4 MHz，桶距 5 ns。26 GeV/c 時 γ = 27.73：Q26（γt = 22.8）η = 1/22.8² − 1/27.73² ≈ 6.2×10⁻⁴；Q20（γt = 18）η ≈ 1.79×10⁻³，約大 2.9 倍。縱向不穩定門檻隨 |η| 上升，因此在相同阻抗下 Q20 可承受更高的束團強度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

steps.objective: 說明「疊片鐵芯與水冷銅線圈」如何決定CERN 超級質子同步加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Laminated yokes and water-cooled copper coils” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPS 共有 1317 台常溫電磁鐵，其中 744 台為偶極，由疊片低碳鋼鐵芯與水冷銅線圈構成，場形由極面形狀決定。鐵芯在 2 T 附近開始飽和，因此 450 GeV 已接近常溫鐵磁鐵的實用上限，這也是 LHC 必須改用超導磁鐵的原因。疊片抑制斜坡時的渦電流，但鐵的磁滯使同一電流下的磁場取決於前一循環的最高場；SPS 在超循環中交錯 LHC、固定靶與其他用戶循環，磁場歷史不斷改變。偶極分為兩種孔徑型式，以配合不同位置的束流尺寸。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「疊片鐵芯與水冷銅線圈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The SPS has 1317 warm electromagnets, 744 of them dipoles, built from laminated low-carbon steel yokes and water-cooled copper coils, with the field shape set by the pole profile. The iron begins to saturate near 2 T, so 450 GeV is close to the practical limit of warm iron magnets, which is why the LHC had to use superconducting magnets. Laminations suppress eddy currents during the ramp, but iron hysteresis makes the field at a given current depend on the previous cycle's peak; the SPS interleaves LHC, fixed-target and other users in a supercycle, so the magnetic history keeps changing. The dipoles come in two aperture types matched to the local beam size. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Laminated yokes and water-cooled copper coils”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 常溫疊片磁鐵、飽和與磁滯歷史：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Warm laminated magnets, saturation and magnetic history: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「疊片鐵芯與水冷銅線圈」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Laminated yokes and water-cooled copper coils” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鐵主導磁鐵所需安匝 NI ≈ B·g/μ₀。假設間隙 g = 40 mm、B = 2.02 T：NI ≈ 2.02×0.04/(4π×10⁻⁷) ≈ 6.4×10⁴ A·匝，接近飽和時鐵的磁阻不可忽略，實際需多出數個百分比。假設剩磁 1.0 mT，相對注入場 0.117 T 佔 0.85%；循環間剩磁變動 1% 時 ΔB/B ≈ 8.5×10⁻⁵，在 D = 3 m 處造成約 0.26 mm 軌道偏移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For an iron-dominated magnet the excitation is NI ≈ B·g/μ₀. Assuming a gap g = 40 mm and B = 2.02 T, NI ≈ 2.02×0.04/(4π×10⁻⁷) ≈ 6.4×10⁴ ampere-turns, and near saturation the iron reluctance adds several percent more. Assuming a remanent field of 1.0 mT, it is 0.85% of the 0.117 T injection field; a 1% cycle-to-cycle change in remanence gives ΔB/B ≈ 8.5×10⁻⁵, an orbit shift of about 0.26 mm where D = 3 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以旋轉線圈或積分線圈量測代表性磁鐵的積分場與多極分量；先後執行不同前置循環（例如先跑 450 GeV 或 400 GeV 循環）再量注入場，建立歷史相依的修正表；運轉中把 B-train 讀值與束流平均徑向位置交叉比對，並記錄線圈冷卻水溫差以追蹤電阻變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure integrated field and multipoles of representative magnets with rotating or integrating coils; run different preceding cycles (for example a 450 GeV or a 400 GeV cycle) before measuring the injection field to build a history-dependent correction table; in operation cross-check the B-train reading against the beam's mean radial position and log coil cooling-water temperature rise to track resistance changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 常溫疊片磁鐵、飽和與磁滯歷史：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「疊片鐵芯與水冷銅線圈」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Laminated yokes and water-cooled copper coils” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以旋轉線圈或積分線圈量測代表性磁鐵的積分場與多極分量；先後執行不同前置循環（例如先跑 450 GeV 或 400 GeV 循環）再量注入場，建立歷史相依的修正表；運轉中把 B-train 讀值與束流平均徑向位置交叉比對，並記錄線圈冷卻水溫差以追蹤電阻變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure integrated field and multipoles of representative magnets with rotating or integrating coils; run different preceding cycles (for example a 450 GeV or a 400 GeV cycle) before measuring the injection field to build a history-dependent correction table; in operation cross-check the B-train reading against the beam's mean radial position and log coil cooling-water temperature rise to track resistance changes. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：冷卻水流量不足使線圈溫升、電阻增加，電源電壓餘裕耗盡，斜坡末段跟不上設定值；輻射區的線圈絕緣老化形成匝間短路，該磁鐵場強下降並扭曲軌道，必須停機更換。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient cooling-water flow heats the coil and raises its resistance until the converter runs out of voltage headroom and the end of the ramp lags the reference; radiation-aged coil insulation develops an inter-turn short, the magnet's field drops and distorts the orbit, and the magnet must be replaced during a stop.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以旋轉線圈或積分線圈量測代表性磁鐵的積分場與多極分量；先後執行不同前置循環（例如先跑 450 GeV 或 400 GeV 循環）再量注入場，建立歷史相依的修正表；運轉中把 B-train 讀值與束流平均徑向位置交叉比對，並記錄線圈冷卻水溫差以追蹤電阻變化。

steps.title: 常溫疊片磁鐵、飽和與磁滯歷史：失效診斷

steps.instructionEn: Insufficient cooling-water flow heats the coil and raises its resistance until the converter runs out of voltage headroom and the end of the ramp lags the reference; radiation-aged coil insulation develops an inter-turn short, the magnet's field drops and distorts the orbit, and the magnet must be replaced during a stop. steps.title: 電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「非晶碳鍍膜真空室」如何決定CERN 超級質子同步加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Amorphous-carbon-coated vacuum chambers” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 25 ns 間隔的高強度質子束團會把真空室壁上的殘餘電子吸向束流中心並加速，電子撞牆時若二次電子產率（SEY）大於 1，電子數隨每個束團倍增而形成電子雲，造成橫向不穩定、發射度增長、壓力上升與熱負載。SPS 在 LS2 期間把 88 支聚焦四極（QF）的束管、相鄰短直線段與部分漂移段鍍上非晶碳，平均最大 SEY 約 0.99，低於漂移管約 1.1、QF 約 1.25 的倍增門檻；MBB 偶極的鍍膜規劃在 LS3 進行。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「非晶碳鍍膜真空室」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: High-intensity proton bunches at 25 ns spacing pull residual electrons off the chamber wall towards the beam and accelerate them; if the secondary-electron yield (SEY) on impact exceeds 1, the electron population multiplies bunch after bunch into an electron cloud, causing transverse instabilities, emittance growth, pressure rise and heat load. During LS2 the SPS coated the beam pipes of its 88 focusing quadrupoles (QF), the adjacent short straight sections and some drifts with amorphous carbon, reaching an average maximum SEY of about 0.99, below multipacting thresholds of about 1.1 in drift tubes and 1.25 in QF chambers; coating of the MBB dipoles is planned for LS3. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Amorphous-carbon-coated vacuum chambers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：束團通過時距中心 r 處靜止電子獲得的能量 ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An electron at rest at distance r from the axis gains ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)² when a bunch passes.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要真空度夠好，就不會產生電子雲。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If the vacuum is good enough, no electron cloud can form." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「非晶碳鍍膜真空室」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Amorphous-carbon-coated vacuum chambers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「非晶碳鍍膜真空室」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Amorphous-carbon-coated vacuum chambers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：束團通過時距中心 r 處靜止電子獲得的能量 ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)²。取 r = 20 mm（假設）、r_e = 2.82×10⁻¹⁵ m：N = 1.15×10¹¹ 時 ΔE ≈ 1022 keV×(0.0162)² ≈ 0.27 keV；N = 2.2×10¹¹（HL-LHC 型）時 ≈ 0.98 keV。前者恰落在未處理金屬 SEY 峰值的數百 eV 附近，強度翻倍後倍增依然存在，必須以鍍膜把最大 SEY 壓到門檻以下。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An electron at rest at distance r from the axis gains ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)² when a bunch passes. With r = 20 mm (assumed) and r_e = 2.82×10⁻¹⁵ m: N = 1.15×10¹¹ gives ΔE ≈ 1022 keV×(0.0162)² ≈ 0.27 keV, and N = 2.2×10¹¹ (HL-LHC type) gives ≈ 0.98 keV. The former sits right at the few-hundred-eV SEY peak of untreated metal, and doubling intensity keeps multipacting alive, so the coating must hold the maximum SEY below threshold. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：鍍膜樣片在實驗室量 SEY 對入射電子能量的曲線並記錄最大值，每次鍍膜批次都留樣；裝機後以真空計壓力上升、帶阻擋柵極的電子雲收集電極電流、逐束團位置訊號與發射度，比較鍍膜段與未鍍段在相同 25 ns 束流下的差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure SEY versus incident electron energy on witness samples in the laboratory and record the maximum, keeping a sample from every coating batch; after installation compare coated and uncoated sections under the same 25 ns beam using vacuum-gauge pressure rise, current on retarding-grid electron-cloud collectors, bunch-by-bunch position signals and emittance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.textEn: An electron at rest at distance r from the axis gains ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)² when a bunch passes. With r = 20 mm (assumed) and r_e = 2.82×10⁻¹⁵ m: N = 1.15×10¹¹ gives ΔE ≈ 1022 keV×(0.0162)² ≈ 0.27 keV, and N = 2.2×10¹¹ (HL-LHC type) gives ≈ 0.98 keV. The former sits right at the few-hundred-eV SEY peak of untreated metal, and doubling intensity keeps multipacting alive, so the coating must hold the maximum SEY below threshold.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating", which statement holds?
options: 450 GeV 遠低於 LHC 的對撞能量，所以注入束流沒有破壞力。
SPS 的磁場在所有能量都固定，只靠提高射頻電壓就能加速。
束團通過時距中心 r 處靜止電子獲得的能量 ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)²。
optionsEn: Because 450 GeV is far below LHC collision energy, injected beam is harmless.
The SPS field stays constant at every energy and acceleration comes only from raising the RF voltage.
An electron at rest at distance r from the axis gains ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)² when a bunch passes.
quiz.explanation: 束團通過時距中心 r 處靜止電子獲得的能量 ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An electron at rest at distance r from the axis gains ΔE ≈ 2m_ec²(N·r_e/r)² when a bunch passes. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「非晶碳鍍膜真空室」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Amorphous-carbon-coated vacuum chambers” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 鍍膜樣片在實驗室量 SEY 對入射電子能量的曲線並記錄最大值，每次鍍膜批次都留樣；裝機後以真空計壓力上升、帶阻擋柵極的電子雲收集電極電流、逐束團位置訊號與發射度，比較鍍膜段與未鍍段在相同 25 ns 束流下的差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure SEY versus incident electron energy on witness samples in the laboratory and record the maximum, keeping a sample from every coating batch; after installation compare coated and uncoated sections under the same 25 ns beam using vacuum-gauge pressure rise, current on retarding-grid electron-cloud collectors, bunch-by-bunch position signals and emittance. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鍍膜附著不良或長期暴露潮濕大氣，SEY 回升到 1.2 以上，高強度 25 ns 束串尾端出現垂直不穩定與發射度增長，只能降低強度或延長洗刷運轉，直接壓縮 LHC 可用的亮度。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Poor coating adhesion or long exposure to humid air lets the SEY climb above 1.2, vertical instabilities and emittance growth appear at the tail of high-intensity 25 ns trains, and the only remedies are lower intensity or longer scrubbing runs, directly cutting the luminosity available to the LHC.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 鍍膜樣片在實驗室量 SEY 對入射電子能量的曲線並記錄最大值，每次鍍膜批次都留樣；裝機後以真空計壓力上升、帶阻擋柵極的電子雲收集電極電流、逐束團位置訊號與發射度，比較鍍膜段與未鍍段在相同 25 ns 束流下的差異。
knowledge.textEn: Measure SEY versus incident electron energy on witness samples in the laboratory and record the maximum, keeping a sample from every coating batch; after installation compare coated and uncoated sections under the same 25 ns beam using vacuum-gauge pressure rise, current on retarding-grid electron-cloud collectors, bunch-by-bunch position signals and emittance.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating"?
options: 鍍膜樣片在實驗室量 SEY 對入射電子能量的曲線並記錄最大值，每次鍍膜批次都留樣。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
轉變能只是低能機器的問題，SPS 這種高能機器不必考慮。
optionsEn: Measure SEY versus incident electron energy on witness samples in the laboratory and record the maximum, keeping a sample from every coating batch.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Transition energy matters only in low-energy machines; a high-energy ring like the SPS can ignore it.
quiz.explanation: 鍍膜樣片在實驗室量 SEY 對入射電子能量的曲線並記錄最大值，每次鍍膜批次都留樣；裝機後以真空計壓力上升、帶阻擋柵極的電子雲收集電極電流、逐束團位置訊號與發射度，比較鍍膜段與未鍍段在相同 25 ns 束流下的差異。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure SEY versus incident electron energy on witness samples in the laboratory and record the maximum, keeping a sample from every coating batch; after installation compare coated and uncoated sections under the same 25 ns beam using vacuum-gauge pressure rise, current on retarding-grid electron-cloud collectors, bunch-by-bunch position signals and emittance. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 電子雲、二次電子產率與鍍膜：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Electron cloud, secondary-electron yield and coating: failure diagnosis

steps.instruction: 鍍膜附著不良或長期暴露潮濕大氣，SEY 回升到 1.2 以上，高強度 25 ns 束串尾端出現垂直不穩定與發射度增長，只能降低強度或延長洗刷運轉，直接壓縮 LHC 可用的亮度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算」與「三階共振慢引出與分離器損失預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget" and "Third-integer slow extraction and the septum loss budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「快速線掃描器」如何決定CERN 超級質子同步加速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fast wire scanners” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPS 送往 LHC 的束流品質以正規化發射度 ε_n 衡量：無擾動時 ε_n 在加速中守恆，而幾何發射度隨 1/(βγ) 縮小。線掃描器以細碳纖維線快速穿過束流，由下游閃爍體量二次粒子簇射得到橫向剖面 σ，再以 ε_n = βγ·(σ² − (D·δ)²)/β_w 換算，其中 β_w 為量測點的 Twiss β 函數、D·δ 為動量分散造成的寬度。誤差來源包括 β_w 的光學誤差、線速度與位置編碼、線材受熱以及量測點色散的修正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「快速線掃描器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The quality of beam sent to the LHC is measured by normalized emittance ε_n, which is conserved during unperturbed acceleration while geometric emittance shrinks as 1/(βγ). A wire scanner sweeps a thin carbon fibre rapidly through the beam, a downstream scintillator records the secondary shower to give the transverse profile σ, and ε_n = βγ·(σ² − (D·δ)²)/β_w converts it, with β_w the Twiss beta at the scanner and D·δ the width from momentum spread. Error sources include optics error in β_w, wire speed and position encoding, wire heating and the dispersion correction at the scanner. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fast wire scanners”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 450 GeV/c βγ = 479.6; assuming ε_n = 2.0 µm and β_w = 70 m, σ = √(2.0×10⁻⁶×70/479.6) ≈ 0.54 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「幾何發射度在加速中守恆，所以不同能量的量測可以直接比較。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Geometric emittance is conserved during acceleration, so measurements at different energies compare directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「快速線掃描器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快速線掃描器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fast wire scanners” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：450 GeV/c 時 βγ = 479.6；假設 ε_n = 2.0 µm、β_w = 70 m：σ = √(2.0×10⁻⁶×70/479.6) ≈ 0.54 mm。若 D = 0.5 m、δ = 3×10⁻⁴，D·δ = 0.15 mm，量得 √(0.54² + 0.15²) ≈ 0.56 mm；忽略色散修正會算成 2.15 µm，高估 7.7%。β_w 的 5% 誤差直接造成 5% 的發射度誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 450 GeV/c βγ = 479.6; assuming ε_n = 2.0 µm and β_w = 70 m, σ = √(2.0×10⁻⁶×70/479.6) ≈ 0.54 mm. With D = 0.5 m and δ = 3×10⁻⁴, D·δ = 0.15 mm and the measured width is √(0.54² + 0.15²) ≈ 0.56 mm; skipping the dispersion correction yields 2.15 µm, a 7.7% overestimate. A 5% error in β_w maps directly into a 5% emittance error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一束流比較正反向掃描、兩台不同位置掃描器及 LHC 注入後的量測；以軌道響應矩陣或逐圈相位前進量測校正 β_w，以改變 RF 頻率量測 D；重複掃描十次求標準差作為統計誤差，與系統誤差平方和合成總不確定度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare in- and out-scans, two scanners at different locations and the measurement after LHC injection on the same beam; calibrate β_w from the orbit-response matrix or turn-by-turn phase advance and measure D by RF-frequency steps; repeat ten scans for the statistical spread and combine it in quadrature with the systematic terms for the total uncertainty.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

quiz.question: 依「發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「快速線掃描器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。

steps.instruction: 以同一束流比較正反向掃描、兩台不同位置掃描器及 LHC 注入後的量測；以軌道響應矩陣或逐圈相位前進量測校正 β_w，以改變 RF 頻率量測 D；重複掃描十次求標準差作為統計誤差，與系統誤差平方和合成總不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare in- and out-scans, two scanners at different locations and the measurement after LHC injection on the same beam; calibrate β_w from the orbit-response matrix or turn-by-turn phase advance and measure D by RF-frequency steps; repeat ten scans for the statistical spread and combine it in quadrature with the systematic terms for the total uncertainty. steps.observation: 注意干擾：束流強度高而線速度不足時，線材被加熱到昇華或斷裂，掃描器失效，碎片落入真空室；若 β_w 校正過時，報告的發射度系統性偏低，直到 LHC 亮度不如預期才被發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: With high intensity and insufficient wire speed the fibre heats until it sublimates or breaks, disabling the scanner and dropping debris into the vacuum chamber; an outdated β_w calibration biases reported emittances low until disappointing LHC luminosity reveals it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「發射度量測與色散修正的誤差預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Emittance measurement and a dispersion-corrected error budget"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。

steps.title: 三階共振慢引出與分離器損失預算：原理與系統邊界

steps.instruction: 送往北區（North Area）固定靶的 400 GeV/c 質子以三階共振慢引出：六極磁鐵在相空間形成三角形穩定區，水平工作點逐漸逼近 80/3 ≈ 26.667，穩定區縮小，粒子沿分離軌跡每三圈向外跨一步，越過靜電分離器（ZS）的細線陣列後被電場偏轉進入引出通道。ZS 由五個各長 3.15 m、每個含 2080 根鎢錸細線的槽構成。約 4.8 s 的平頂把約 3.5×10¹³ 顆質子均勻送出，形成實驗所需的長 spill；打在線上的質子造成損失與活化，是慢引出的核心限制。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「靜電分離器鎢錸線陣列」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

The ZS consists of five 3.15 m tanks, each with 2080 tungsten–rhenium wires. A flat top of about 4.8 s spreads roughly 3.5×10¹³ protons into the long spill experiments need, and protons striking the wires cause loss and activation, the central limit of slow extraction. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：損失比例 ≈ 有效分離器寬度/三圈步距。有效寬度 0.55 mm、假設步距 17 mm：損失 ≈ 3.2%；每次 3.5×10¹³ 顆中約 1.1×10¹² 顆打在分離器區，能量 1.1×10¹²×400 GeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J/GeV ≈ 73 kJ，10.8 s 循環平均約 6.7 kW。彎晶遮蔽使損失再降約 40%，比例約 1.9%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

Bent-crystal shadowing cuts the loss by about 40% more, to roughly 1.9%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “TI2/TI8 lines and injection-protection collimators” determines the key performance of “CERN Super Proton Synchrotron”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: SPS 把 450 GeV 束串經 TI2 與 TI8 兩條長度約 2.5 至 2.7 km 的傳輸線分別送進 LHC 的兩個環。引出踢磁鐵必須在束串間隙內上升到位，任何時序或強度錯誤都可能讓整串高能束流打到傳輸線或 LHC 注入區，因此傳輸線末端設有可移動的注入保護準直器（TCDI），引出前由互鎖系統檢查軌道、強度與磁鐵電流，並先以低強度探針束驗證路徑。束串的強度與發射度決定 LHC 亮度，也決定出錯時的破壞力。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「TI2/TI8 傳輸線與注入保護準直器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The SPS sends 450 GeV trains into the LHC's two rings through the TI2 and TI8 transfer lines, each roughly 2.5 to 2.7 km long. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一串 4×72 = 288 束團、每束團 1.15×10¹¹ 顆、450 GeV：E = 288×1.15×10¹¹×450×1.602×10⁻¹⁰ J ≈ 2.4 MJ；LIU 強度 2.3×10¹¹ 時約 4.8 MJ。熔化 1 kg 銅需 385×1058 + 2.05×10⁵ ≈ 6.1×10⁵ J，一串足以熔化約 3.9 至 7.8 kg 銅。LHC 每環 2808 束團約需 2808/288 ≈ 10 次轉移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

steps.title: 多用戶超循環、射頻冗餘與 LIU 驗收：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「200 MHz 固態功率放大器與超循環」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：N 路功率合成少一路輸入時輸出 ≈ P₀(1 − 1/N)²。每座 80 模組的放大塔失去 1 個模組：144×(79/80)² ≈ 140.4 kW，僅降 2.5%；全系統 2560 模組總額定 2560×1.8 kW ≈ 4.6 MW。固定靶循環 10.8 s 中平頂 4.8 s，工作因子 4.8/10.8 ≈ 44%；超循環插入 LHC 填充循環時，北區平均強度按時間比例下降。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An N-way combiner missing one input delivers ≈ P₀(1 − 1/N)². An 80-module tower losing one module gives 144×(79/80)² ≈ 140.4 kW, only 2.5% less; the 2560 modules total 2560×1.8 kW ≈ 4.6 MW rated. A 10.8 s fixed-target cycle with a 4.8 s flat top has a duty factor of 4.8/10.8 ≈ 44%, and inserting LHC filling cycles into the supercycle lowers North Area average intensity in proportion to time. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐座放大塔量測輸出功率、相位與增益，並刻意停用模組測試降級後的腔電壓與束流穩定；束流端以與 LHC 要求並列的表格驗證每束團強度、發射度、束團長度與束串間一致性；統計一個運轉期的射頻故障停機時數計算可用度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure output power, phase and gain of each tower and deliberately disable modules to test cavity voltage and beam stability in degraded operation; on the beam side verify bunch intensity, emittance, bunch length and train-to-train consistency in a table beside the LHC requirements; tally RF fault downtime over a run to compute availability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

A single-point cooling or power fault that drops several towers at once defeats the parallel redundancy, cavity voltage falls short and high-intensity beam is lost from the bucket during the ramp.
quiz.explanation: 冷卻水或電源的單點故障同時切掉多座放大塔時，並聯冗餘失效，腔電壓不足使高強度束流在斜坡中失捕而損失；排程若只追求北區強度而壓縮 LHC 循環，填充延遲，整體物理產出反而下降。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A single-point cooling or power fault that drops several towers at once defeats the parallel redundancy, cavity voltage falls short and high-intensity beam is lost from the bucket during the ramp; a schedule that squeezes LHC cycles to maximize North Area intensity delays fills and lowers total physics output. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
